title: Add Metrics Drilldown visualization to a dashboard

blocks.content:
A Grafana dashboard is a set of one or more panels, organized and arranged into one or more rows, that provide an at-a-glance view of related information. These panels are created using components that query and transform raw data from a data source into visualizations.

A data source can be an SQL database, Grafana Loki, Grafana Mimir, or an API endpoint. It can even be a basic CSV file. Data source plugins take a query you want answered, retrieve the data from the data source, and reconcile the differences between the data model of the data source and the data model of Grafana dashboards.

To add a Metrics Drilldown visualization to a dashboard, complete the following steps:
**New dashboard** is already selected. To use a dashboard you already have, select **Existing dashboard** and choose it from **Select dashboard**. Otherwise, skip this step.

blocks.reftarget: button[data-testid='data-testid Add to dashboard confirm button']
blocks.content: Click **Open dashboard**. The panel opens on the dashboard.

blocks.reftarget: input[data-testid='data-testid Panel editor option pane field input Title']
blocks.content: In the **Panel** sidebar, replace **New Panel** in **Title** with a name for this visualization.
In **Save dashboard**, **Title** is the dashboard name. It starts as New dashboard. Change it if you want. **Description** is optional. **Folder** is already **Dashboards**. Then click **Save**.
